selection.scope: one pattern and material palette per connected edge chain; never reroll each tile
selection.public_edges: choose one style per bridge or waterfront zone

assembly.placement: align start to previous end; rotate by matching end/start tangents
assembly.height: attach floor/path sockets to walking surface; top handrail sockets must meet exactly
assembly.curve: fixed-radius arc modules; never nonuniformly scale curves
assembly.corner: Corner90 preserves a continuous top rail through the 90 degree turn
assembly.stair: 3m rise / 3.75m run, 15x200mm risers and 250mm treads; mount beside the flight
assembly.stairs_both_sides: duplicate with lateral offset; no full-flight collider in the walkway
assembly.wall_mount: WallHandrail and StairHandrail have brackets and no floor posts
assembly.shared_posts: hide previous EndPost when next StartPost occupies the same socket; keep the final EndPost
assembly.terminal_height: scale a simple EndPost vertically by selected asset height / 1.1; TransitionPost supports joining distinct rail heights
assembly.short_remainder: trim/regenerate the final straight tile with capped rails; do not stretch a 2m tile along a whole bridge
assembly.door_and_stair_landings: split edge chains at access openings; keep thresholds and landings clear

collision.method: separate thin edge barrier; stair barrier follows rise; do not use entire railing AABB as a filled box
collision.clearance: keep route width and door keepouts from parent building/street rules
collision.ends: no collider across a gate or access opening

rendering.lod1: keep posts and top rail; omit ornamental infill
rendering.lod2: edge silhouette or omit below pixel threshold
rendering.frustum_culling: per edge chunk, with model bounds
rendering.shadow_budget: nearby rails only; simplify distant shadow casters
